question: What are the key risks for Diginex?

beats.line: Diginex faces a data reliability risk. The ESG reporting landscape remains highly fragmented.
beats.headline: DATA RELIABILITY
beats.action: [0-5s] A stack of halftone paper documents lands on a torn grid-paper map and splits into uneven piles. [5-10s] The piles drift apart across the map, leaving gaps, and settle holding on the document stack.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex faces a data reliability risk. The ESG reporting landscape remains highly fragmented.

beats.line: Standards vary across jurisdictions and industries, so data quality and comparability pose significant challenges.
beats.headline: VARYING STANDARDS
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous headline chip slides off the top edge as the document stack fans out and mismatched paper rubber stamps press onto each sheet. [5-10s] The stamped sheets are gathered back into the document stack, edges refusing to align, holding on the stack.
beats.delivery: Standards vary across jurisdictions and industries, so data quality and comparability pose significant challenges.

beats.line: If its platforms miss regulatory-grade data, credibility with institutional clients or regulators could suffer.
beats.headline: CREDIBILITY
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips away as the document stack feeds into a paper screen that flickers and drops a torn strip. [5-10s] The torn strip curls down past the screen and rests against the document stack, holding on the stack.
beats.delivery: If its platforms miss regulatory-grade data, credibility with institutional clients or regulators could suffer.

beats.line: Revenue growth has been strong, up two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.
beats.headline: +293% TO $2.0M
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip slides off as the document stack folds into a paper bar chart and a stencilled arrow climbs steeply across it. [5-10s] The arrow reaches the tallest bar and holds there, the chart settling under it, holding on the bar chart.
beats.delivery: [excited] Revenue growth has been strong, up two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.

beats.line: But the market questions how repeatable that growth is, given the mix of one-off and recurring revenue.
beats.headline: REPEATABLE?
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip lifts away as the bar chart tips and spills into two separate paper coin piles. [5-10s] One pile is swept off frame while the other stays, then the bars rebuild shorter, holding on the bar chart.
beats.delivery: But the market questions how repeatable that growth is, given the mix of one-off and recurring revenue.

beats.line: The strategy leans on acquisitions and partnerships, so execution is the key risk.
beats.headline: EXECUTION RISK
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips down as the bar chart's bars separate into paper building blocks joined by string and pins. [5-10s] The strings pull the blocks toward one another and stop short of touching, holding on the block cluster.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] The strategy leans on acquisitions and partnerships, so execution is the key risk.

beats.line: If integrating the large Resulticks acquisition drags, investor confidence could remain weak.
beats.headline: INTEGRATION
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip slides off as a paper calendar strip unrolls beneath the block cluster and a paper hand pushes one oversized block along it. [5-10s] The hand keeps pushing page after page and the block stalls mid-strip, holding on the block cluster.
beats.delivery: If integrating the large Resulticks acquisition drags, investor confidence could remain weak.

beats.line: There's also client adoption risk. ESG adoption remains uneven across sectors and geographies.
beats.headline: UNEVEN ADOPTION
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip lifts as the block cluster flattens into a torn grid-paper map and hole-punched tags drop onto some regions only. [5-10s] The bare regions of the map tilt into view, tagless, holding on the torn map.
beats.delivery: There's also client adoption risk. ESG adoption remains uneven across sectors and geographies.

beats.line: Smaller enterprises may delay on cost or complexity, and many still treat compliance as box-ticking.
beats.headline: BOX-TICKING
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips away as the torn map folds into a paper checklist and a paper hand ticks each box fast without reading. [5-10s] The hand withdraws and the checklist curls at one corner, holding on the paper checklist.
beats.delivery: Smaller enterprises may delay on cost or complexity, and many still treat compliance as box-ticking.

beats.line: If ESG stays underprioritised, sales cycles may lengthen and slow annual recurring revenue growth.
beats.headline: LONGER CYCLES
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip slides off as the checklist gathers back into the document stack and a paper calendar strip stretches out beside it. [5-10s] A stencilled arrow crawls slowly along the lengthened strip and stops, the strip now taped to the document stack, holding on the stack.
beats.delivery: If ESG stays underprioritised, sales cycles may lengthen and slow annual recurring revenue growth.
